description.value: Van Bahn Mi & Yoghurt is a Vietnamese fast-food spot in Vancouver's Pacific Street area specializing in bánh mì sandwiches across a wide range of fillings — from lemongrass grilled chicken to a fully vegan tofu-and-avocado option — alongside house-made yogurt cups and smoothies. The menu is compact and takeout-oriented, making it a quick, affordable refuelling stop. Online ordering is available through multiple delivery platforms for those who want food ready on arrival.
